subject: SIG bundle and procurement upload: manifest, PDFs, and checklist
messages:
From: Lucas Grant <lucas.grant@finserve.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finserve.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: SIG export + procurement bundle request (PO coming)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick responses earlier. Our procurement team needs a complete SIG bundle to close the SOW: consolidated SIG PDF, all supporting evidence (PDF/CSV), SOC 2 report, and a one-page security summary we can attach to the PO. We will be raising PO# 98765.

Two notes from procurement:
- Files should be uploaded to our OneTrust portal record (link below) and we also maintain a Whistic mirror for vendor scoring.
- We need a manifest CSV that maps SIG question IDs to the exact attachment filenames (for our audit).

Can you confirm you can deliver the upload and manifest by EOD Thu 18 Jun? If not, please propose an earlier interim deliverable so the buyer can start reviews.

Onetrust record: https://app.onetrust.com/portal/records/FS-3456
Whistic record: https://app.whistic.com/vendor/redwood/record/987654

Thanks,
Lucas
Lucas Grant
Sr. Procurement Manager
FinServe Inc.
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG export + procurement bundle request (PO coming)

Team — looping you in. FinServe wants a procurement-ready bundle and portal uploads by Thu 18 Jun. Please find the minimum deliverables they listed and owners below: 

Ask / deliverables we should produce:
- Consolidated SIG PDF (answers + metadata) -> Marissa to run the export and embed attachments where possible.
- Evidence attachments (PDFs, screenshots, config exports) -> Sergio to assemble and normalize filenames.
- CSV manifest mapping SIG QIDs -> attachment filenames -> me (So) to validate and sign-off.
- SOC2 Type II PDF and one-page security summary -> Markus to attach and provide the short summary for procurement.
- Final zip (named Redwood_FinServe_SIG_20260618.zip) and upload to OneTrust + Whistic (portal IDs above).

Notes / constraints:
- OneTrust expects a single PDF for the questionnaire (they prefer embedded answers); Whistic supports discrete attachments. We'll produce both formats.
- Please use the filename convention: vendor_product_YYYYMMDD_description.ext (see Marissa's checklist below).
- Keep total zip under 150MB; if larger, provide a Drive link and the portal upload stub.

Attachments referenced: SIG-evidence-manifest-20260612-draft.csv (draft mapping)

Marissa — can you confirm the export format and ETA? Sergio — start gathering evidence. Markus — can you draft the 1-page summary? I'll own the manifest and the portal uploads.

Thanks,
So + Redwood Security Ops
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG export + procurement bundle request (PO coming)

Confirming export approach:
- I'll export the SIG from our questionnaire tool as a consolidated PDF (answers + timestamps). The export will also include a CSV of the QID -> answer mapping which we'll merge with Sergio's evidence filenames.
- I'll produce an "index" PDF (first page) that lists attachment filenames and a short content summary for the buyer — procurement likes that.
- DocuSign: if they want an attestation page signed, I can populate a simple attestation template and send for signature.

Filename convention I'll use: redwood_sig_20260616_consolidated.pdf and evidence files like redwood_evidence_20260616_encryption-config.pdf

ETA: draft consolidated PDF + draft manifest by Mon 15 Jun EOD. Finalized bundle ready for upload by Wed 17 Jun EOD, earlier if Sergio/internals turn things around.

Marissa
Product Security Ops
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: legal@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG export + procurement bundle request (PO coming)

Thanks — a couple procurement items to note (legal copied):
- Procurement requires an invoice and the expected contract term (we should provide a short cover pdf: procurement-invoice-Redwood-PO98765.pdf).
- They asked for any deviations in control coverage (we should surface 3 potential exceptions in the one-pager and call them out explicitly).
- For the evidence package, ensure access-control screenshots include role names and timestamps (audit logs). That will avoid back-and-forth.

I'll draft the one-page security summary and add the exceptions section. Soojin — please add the HubSpot deal link to the upload notes (we'll record the upload in DEAL-2026-998).

Markus
VP, Security & Compliance
From: Lucas Grant <lucas.grant@finserve.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finserve.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG export + procurement bundle request (PO coming)

Appreciate the plan. Two quick follow-ups:
- Can you include specific evidence showing encryption at rest for customer data (config screenshot + KMS reference)?
- Procurement also needs a short, labelled file called "Redwood_Procurement_Summary.pdf" that contains PO number, contact, and summary of deliverables for the finance team.

If you can get these two items by Wed 17 Jun morning that would be ideal. We'll issue PO# 98765 once the procurement summary and invoice are visible.

Thanks,
Lucas
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Lucas Grant <lucas.grant@finserve.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 10:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG export + procurement bundle request (PO coming) — upload complete (OneTrust + Whistic)

Lucas — quick status. We've completed the bundle and uploaded to both portals. Summary below and files attached to this thread for your convenience.

What we uploaded (primary filenames):
- Redwood_SIG_Consolidated_20260616.pdf (consolidated questionnaire PDF)
- SOC2-Type-II-Redwood-2025.pdf (latest SOC2 report)
- Redwood_Procurement_Summary.pdf (PO# 98765, contact, deliverables)
- SIG-evidence-manifest-20260616.csv (QID -> attachment mapping)
- procurement-invoice-Redwood-PO98765.pdf (invoice stub)
- redwood_evidence_20260616_encryption-config.pdf (encryption at rest screenshot + KMS reference)
- upload-checklist-OneTrust-Whistic.txt (internal upload notes)

Portal links (uploaded):
- OneTrust: https://app.onetrust.com/portal/records/FS-3456 (document set: Redwood - SIG bundle)
- Whistic: https://app.whistic.com/vendor/redwood/record/987654 (attachments uploaded)

HubSpot & tracking: DEAL-2026-998 updated with upload artifacts and timestamps.

Next steps:
- Markus will follow with the one-page exceptions summary and attestation if procurement requests signature.
- Sergio will hand off the original evidence files to Legal for retention.

Let me know if you need any additional items or if procurement wants us to push a signed attestation.

Regards,
So (Sojin Lee)
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
